killedBy: the controller self-test pane (issue #599) replaces the developer shell rather than stacking on it, and Back lands on the menu
why: `openSurface()` is the SOURCE of every transition, so a surface missing from PANEL_FAMILY cannot be the one a navigation leaves. Opening the self-test then sources from the Main Menu panel instead and leaves the developer shell DISPLAYED underneath it -- two surfaces on screen at once. This is the state the shell actually shipped in (issue #243); nothing could observe it until a pane was reachable FROM the shell.
